# High-rate AAC remux fixtures

Generated by FFmpeg 9.0.2 solely as test/reference input:

```
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=1000:sample_rate=96000:duration=0.064' -c:a aac -b:a 96k -aac_pns 0 -f adts aac-96k.aac
ffmpeg -v error -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=1000:sample_rate=88200:duration=0.064' -c:a aac -b:a 96k -aac_pns 0 -f adts aac-88k.aac
```

The owned remuxer uses QuickTime v2 sound descriptions for these rates, a qt
compatible brand, f64 sample rate and u32 channel count. Description reference:
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/quicktime-file-format/sound_sample_description_version_2
Tests compare each AAC packet and owned decoded PCM before/after muxing.
Independent ffprobe recognized 96000 Hz, mono, seven packets; FFmpeg decoding
of the written container matched reference decoding of the ADTS bytes exactly.
